starter_messages.knock-first: Welcome to The Trap House. This is 18+ documentary/archive space: website is the map, Discord is the room, Trap Pass gets you deeper. This is not instructions, a challenge, medical advice, or a place to source anything. Pull up, read the rules, grab a pass if you want keys, and start with the map. Welcome to the dirt show.
starter_messages.house-rules: Grimey house rules: keep it raw, keep it useful. No sourcing, selling, plugs, instructions, threats, doxxing, minors, reposting private material, spam floods, or telling people to imitate dangerous footage. Heavy material goes in heavy rooms. Mods can clean risky stuff so the house stays standing.
starter_messages.the-map-on-the-wall: The Threads are how the whole project connects. January 22 is the blast crater. Grief feeds addiction. Addiction feeds money desperation and psychosis loops. Cats/home interrupt collapse. Writing turns collapse into evidence. Platform war forces migration. Trap Passes turn viewers into participants. In the end, all threads converge.

site_integrations: Discord invite URL stays manual until approved for public site display.
Trap Pass IDs map to Discord roles through the same shareable summary used by the Pass Terminal.
Threads data powers site route copy, Discord thread rooms, and Trap Pass affinity.
Mission Board can mirror mission drops into #caption-lab, #thumbnail-court, and #clip-reactions.
AI Archive Terminal can post batch status into #archive-dives and the archive status lane.
Approved Discord submissions can become website story objects after human review.
